svg.title: hop-out / exit ladder
svg.desc: Four synthetic sale sizes, 10, 25, 50 and 100 percent, with estimated proceeds and haircut. Larger sales lose more to price impact.

g.text: PROCEEDS AS A SHARE OF SPOT VALUE
